script: From week three to week eight, practise and build your portfolio. This is the core of the course. Make at least six sample pieces of work, each for an imaginary or real small business. Chapter five explains exactly how. From week eight to week ten, find your first clients. Start outreach once you have three samples and a basic profile. Chapter seven gives you the message templates. From week ten to week twelve, deliver and get paid. Your first job should be small and clearly defined. Chapter nine shows you how to deliver it and send your invoice. Measure your progress by output, not by hours. At the end of each week, write down what you made and what you learned. Three finished samples are worth more than fifteen hours of watching videos. A common mistake is to try to learn everything at once. You may open ten tabs, watch five courses and feel busy, but finish nothing. Instead, pick one course and finish it. Then pick one small project from that course and finish it too.
